items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no direct statement from Gil Evans regarding Simon Trapp. The mention appears only in a note '[(note)] OSCAR AND SIMON TRAPP' inserted by the interviewer or editor, not in Evans' spoken words.

ctx.x: Then I stopped taking that treatment for a while. And then I went to the same man's brother out in Long Island a few times. Anyhow, it wasn't too long after that he died too.
